name: Julian Rhind-Tutt
biography: Julian Alistair Rhind-Tutt (born 20 July 1968, West Drayton, Hillingdon, London) is an English actor. He is best known for his starring role as Dr "Mac" Macartney in the comedy television series Green Wing, the second series of which finished on Channel 4 in May 2006. He has also appeared in various other television shows and films.
